# depends on the architecture, these are amd64's, which purse-dcrutil gives on
# every target. Corpus: tests/common/mod.rs with
# SplitMix64(0x6463727574696c03): txsort_hex_corpus(20, 8) (the upstream
# testdata and 20 random transactions), random_fields_txs(20, 8), the key
# sequences of sort_key_corpus(1) of at most 257 keys (its shortestShifting
# block of 49 and 50 keys with ties included) as tagged transactions; entries
# per command (hex, fields, tagged) [29, 20, 199]. Written by
# `PURSE_DCRUTIL_REGEN=1 cargo test -p purse-dcrutil --test oracle --
# --ignored regenerate_frozen_vectors`, which also checked the Rust crate
# equal to every answer. Each line: {"cmd": oracle command, "in": one element
